newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Mining copper smelter to shut for repairs.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Mining copper smelter to shut for repairs.

text.p: Copper smelter at Mitsui Mining and Smelting Co's majority-owned Hibi Kyodo Smelting Co will be shut from October 4 to 31 for scheduled maintenance, a spokesman said on Monday.

He added that closure of the smelter, with annual capacity of 262,800 tonnes, would not affect Mitsui's planned copper output of 79,700 tonnes in the half-year to March 1997. Copper blister will be supplied to Hibi's 190,800 tonne-per-year refinery from stocks.
Mitsui owns 63.5 percent of Hibi, while Nittetsu Mining Co and Furukawa Co own the remainder.
